name: OpenRouter API Cost
author: Neil
description: OpenRouter API spend in an Omarchy bar dropdown: last hour, today, this week and this month, per-key limits, and credit balance.

barWidget.description: Tracks OpenRouter API spend. The bar shows the OpenRouter icon (working), ⚠ (no key) or ! (error); click opens a dropdown with last-hour/today/week/month spend, per-key limits and credit balance.
